title: 16600 - 16600/P0216/000534
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Reduced fuel economy and engine performance
stepByStepSolution: Ohm test N108 and wiring harness, see factory repair manual
Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  failed N108 or failed Injection Pump.
technicalNotes:
For the ALH engine
The N108 should be between 12 to 20 ohms.
With the engine at idle and up to operating temperature, go into Temel Ayarları (Basic Settings) Yapın:  group 004.  Field 3 should should read between 7.0 to 9.0 degrees, then about 10 seconds later drop to 3.0 to 5.0 degrees.
If air is getting sucked into the fuel supply, this can cause the P0216. Kontrol edin:  for cracks at the fuel pick up in the fuel tank, and at the fittings for the fuel filter.
